ladder.why_zh: 失败周期——价格跌破了启动本周期的低点，历史上这通常意味着更大的趋势正在掉头向下（约 80% 的情形）。
ladder.next_zh: 观望，直至新的日线周期低点形成并确认。
ladder.regime_line_zh: 大局：看多 — 周线动量为正（投资者周期第 13 周 · 日线周期于 1 天前跌破其起始低点）。
ladder.summary_line_zh: 短期（日线）：下跌趋势。大局（顺势）：看多。
points_zh: 大局为看多（对日线多头而言属顺势）
宏观：美国净流动性收缩——对概率属需谨慎
⚠ 失败周期——价格跌破了启动本周期的低点（1 天前）
摆动低点已现（买方拒绝了该低点）
仍位于 10 日均线之下
日线动量刚刚向下交叉
ladder.liq_line: Macro headwind: US net liquidity is contracting — buy setups have historically had worse odds and deeper drawdowns here, so demand extra confirmation and smaller size. An odds edge, not a forecast.
ladder.liq_line_zh: 宏观逆风：美国净流动性正在收缩——在此环境下买入形态历史上胜率更低、回撤更深，因此应要求更多确认并降低仓位。这是概率优势，并非预测。
ladder.age_line: ⏱ DOWNTREND signal triggered 1 trading day ago (~2026-06-17), switching from TOPPING. Signal strength: strong (score -80/100).
ladder.age_line_zh: ⏱ 下跌趋势信号于 1 个交易日前触发（约 2026-06-17），自做顶中切换而来。 信号强度：强（评分 -80/100）。
ladder.eq_label_zh: 入场质量：偏弱卖出/离场形态（-27）
ladder.eq_tip: How well-timed & low-risk THIS entry is — near the cycle high, a fresh momentum turn, and with-trend. Measured: entries near the pivot drew ~30% smaller drawdowns than chasers far above it — risk control, NOT a return forecast.
ladder.eq_tip_zh: 衡量当前入场的时机与风险——贴近周期高点、动量新近转向、且顺势。实测：贴近枢轴的入场，其回撤比远离枢轴的追高者约小 30%——这是风险控制，并非收益预测。
ladder.bc_line_zh: 日线 ✗ · 3日 ✗ · 周线 ✗ · 月线 —
ladder.bc_tip: Confidence this is a DURABLE, low-drawdown bottom: how near price is to the cycle low (the drawdown-depth axis) discounted when higher timeframes haven't confirmed the turn. Measured: weekly confirmation lifted the 'cycle-low held' rate ~19pp — a higher score held far more often. Risk/durability, NOT a return forecast.
ladder.bc_tip_zh: 衡量当前是否为「持久、低回撤」底部的信心：价格距周期低点的远近（回撤深度轴），并在更高周期尚未确认转向时打折。实测：周线确认使「周期低点守住」的比例提升约 19 个百分点——分数越高，低点守住的概率越大。这是风险/持久性，并非收益预测。
ladder.bc_knife_line: ⚠ Deep washout — price is 27% below its 200-day, a broken primary trend. Measured: setups this stretched below the 200-day held the cycle low only ~37% of the time and drew a ~−22% tail (violent bounces, rarely the durable low). Treat as knife-risk — wait for it to reclaim the 10-day average and size small. The score above is already tempered for this.
ladder.bc_knife_line_zh: ⚠ 深度超卖——价格较 200 日均线低约 27%（主趋势已破）。实测：如此远低于 200 日线的形态，仅约 37% 守住周期低点，且回撤尾部约 −22%（反弹猛烈，但很少是持久低点）。视为「接飞刀」风险——等其收复 10 日均线后再小仓参与。上方分数已据此打折。

profile.description: Perrigo Company plc is an American Irish-registered manufacturer of private label over-the-counter pharmaceuticals, and while 70% of Perrigo's net sales are from the U.S. healthcare system, Perrigo is legally headquartered in Ireland for tax purposes, which accounts for 0.60% of net sales.
profile.description_zh: Perrigo Company plc 是一家美国公司在爱尔兰注册的制造商，生产自有品牌非处方药。尽管Perrigo 70%的净销售额来自美国医疗体系，但其出于税务目的合法将总部设在爱尔兰，该地仅占净销售额的0.60%。
